evidence.description: The static shared instance exposes mutable latestMonth and latestReport properties on a nonisolated class.
fetchAndUpdate writes both shared instance properties without synchronization.

candidates.explanation: FinancialReports exposes mutable instance state through its static shared instance without actor isolation or synchronization. latestMonth and latestReport are publicly readable and are updated by fetchAndUpdate, leaving the shared state unprotected.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
